DIS.note: Historical source used only for Korean spelling; current operation is separately checked against MTR CSV.

ADM.note: Ocean Park travel tip explicitly pairs Admiralty with this Korean spelling.

OCP.note: Same travel tip explicitly names Ocean Park station.

WCH.note: Current Korean travel directions name this MTR station; historical guide uses 원창항.

LET.note: Travel directions identify MTR Lei Tung via its Ap Lei Chau A1 exit. Cross-checked with MTR English station master. No automatic-translation notice in the opened page.

SOH.note: Horizon Plaza and Space Outlet directions pair this spelling with South Horizon station. Historical spelling evidence only.

HOK.note: Airport Express transfer information explicitly pairs Hong Kong station.

KOW.note: Airport Express transfer information explicitly pairs Kowloon station. Do not use the separate Disney paragraph which incorrectly pairs Hong Kong and Kowloon.

TSY.note: 2014 Hong Kong Magic Lamp, publisher Hong Kong Tourism Board Korea office, overview map explicitly pairs Tsing Yi. Mirror of the publication; original PDF unavailable.

AIR.note: Same publisher/imprint and overview map explicitly pair Airport station; this is the historical Korean station label, not an invented translation.

AWE.note: Same overview map explicitly pairs AsiaWorld-Expo station. Historical spelling only, current stops are checked independently.

TAK.note: Tai Koo shopping directions explicitly pair Tai Koo station.

CAB.note: Fashion Walk directions explicitly pair Causeway Bay station.

LOW.note: City transport section explicitly pairs Lo Wu station; historical spelling only.

LMC.note: City transport section explicitly pairs Lok Ma Chau station; historical spelling only.

CHW.note: Travel directions explicitly name MTR Chai Wan station.

SKW.note: Return travel directions explicitly name MTR Shau Kei Wan station.

KET.note: Getting to Belcher Bay specifies Kennedy Town MTR exit C.

FOH.note: Access points 1 and 2 identify Fortress Hill MTR exit A.

NOP.note: Access points 4 through 7 identify North Point MTR exit A1.

QUB.note: Access points 9 and 10 identify Quarry Bay MTR exit C.

SYP.note: Sun Yat Sen park access names Sai Ying Pun and Sheung Wan stations.

SHW.note: Current park access names Sheung Wan; old publication spelling 성완 retained as an alias.

WAC.note: Lee Tung Avenue access explicitly names Wan Chai MTR station.

OLY.note: 2014 publication hotel map explicitly pairs Olympic Station. Original publisher imprint checked on mirrored text.
